attrs.gap: R6's applies-under rule requires exact equality between an argument's assumptions and its conclusion claim's. GPT-5.6's audit is right that this is correct for the current artifact and wrong as a general semantics: with P ⇒ C and independently Q ⇒ C, the claim is not conditional on P ∧ Q, and forcing the union onto the claim states a hypothesis the claim does not have. R6.1 SCOPES the rule to single-leg claims rather than weakening it, and §5c EXHIBITS the failure — it builds a two-leg fixture, runs naive exact equality against it, and asserts that the naive rule raises spurious complaints. Candidate richer forms: common claim assumptions plus per-leg assumptions, or an assumption formula over support alternatives. Every claim in this artifact has at most one argument, so nothing here can distinguish them.
